gloss: to send back; to return; to remand

definitions.gloss: to send back; to return (documents, items)
definitions.explanation: To return something to its original sender or location, often documents or submissions that require revision.

definitions.gloss: to remand (a case to a lower court)
definitions.explanation: Legal term for sending a case back to a lower court for retrial or reconsideration.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}が{差|さ}し{戻|もど}された。
{書類|しょるい}に{不備|ふび}があったため、{差|さ}し{戻|もど}された。
examples.english: The documents were sent back because there were deficiencies.

examples.japanese: {申請書|しんせいしょ}を{修正|しゅうせい}して{再提出|さいていしゅつ}するよう{差|さ}し{戻|もど}しを{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received a request to revise and resubmit the application.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}を{高裁|こうさい}に{差|さ}し{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: The case was remanded to the High Court.

examples.japanese: {最高裁|さいこうさい}は{判決|はんけつ}を{取|と}り{消|け}し、{事件|じけん}を{原審|げんしん}に{差|さ}し{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: The Supreme Court overturned the verdict and remanded the case to the original court.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{戻|もど}し{審|しん}では、{新|あたら}しい{証拠|しょうこ}も{検討|けんとう}された。
examples.english: In the retrial after remand, new evidence was also examined.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: XがYを{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す

COMPOUND VERB STRUCTURE:
{差|さ}す (various meanings including 'to send') + {戻|もど}す (to return) = to send back

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{書類|しょるい}を{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す - to return documents
・{申請|しんせい}を{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す - to send back an application
・{事件|じけん}を{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す - to remand a case
・{原審|げんしん}に{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す - to remand to the original court

NOUN FORM:
{差|さ}し{戻|もど}し - the act of sending back; remand
・{差|さ}し{戻|もど}し{審|しん} - retrial after remand

LEGAL CONTEXT:
In Japanese law, {差|さ}し{戻|もど}し is a technical term used when a higher court sends a case back to a lower court. Different from {破棄|はき} (reversal) which simply overturns without requiring retrial.

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Common in administrative, business, and legal contexts.
